420	/// After hydrating session content and reducing `pending_events`, clients install
   421	/// every field here as the final active/terminal/reroute/permission/browser
   422	/// value. Components are intentionally absent: reconstruct their canonical
   423	/// registry by scanning checkpoint/session tool context in order and applying a
   424	/// `component_render`/`component_unmount` call only after a later successful
   425	/// (`is_error == false`) result with the same `tool_call_id`. Failed, missing,
   426	/// or result-before-call pairs have no component effect. Then reduce component
   427	/// frames after the checkpoint. Folded fields are not reducer inputs.
   428	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
   429	pub struct SessionProjectionState {
   430	    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
   431	    pub active_turn: Option<Value>,
   432	    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
   433	    pub last_turn_finished: Option<Value>,
   434	    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
   435	    pub model_rerouted: Option<Value>,
   436	    #[serde(default)]
   437	    pub pending_permissions: Vec<Value>,
   438	    #[serde(default)]
   439	    pub browser_active: bool,
   440	}
   441	
   442	/// Typed durable transcript/tool replacement carried by checkpoint frames.
   443	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
   444	#[serde(tag = "type", deny_unknown_fields)]
   445	pub enum SessionProjectionCheckpoint {
   446	    /// Inline normalized replacement. Clients replace transcript/tool context
   447	    /// and reconstruct components by scanning tool context in order: retain a
   448	    /// component render/unmount call until a later result with the same call id,
   449	    /// apply it only when that result has `is_error == false`, and discard it on
   450	    /// failed or missing result. Raw provider messages and image/base64 bytes are
   451	    /// deliberately absent.
   452	    #[serde(rename = "projection_checkpoint")]
   453	    Inline {
   454	        persistence_revision: u64,
   455	        transcript: Vec<SessionTranscriptEntry>,
   456	        tool_context: Vec<SessionToolContext>,
   457	    },
   458	    /// The exact replacement exceeded the journal's inline bound. A live-tail
   459	    /// client must stop and refetch the canonical session snapshot. On the fresh
   460	    /// GET that follows, canonical `session` content already satisfies this
   461	    /// marker, so it is not recursively refetched.
   462	    #[serde(rename = "projection_checkpoint_refetch")]
   463	    Refetch { persistence_revision: u64 },
   464	}
   465	
   466	impl SessionProjectionCheckpoint {
   467	    pub fn persistence_revision(&self) -> u64 {
   468	        match self {
   469	            Self::Inline {
   470	                persistence_revision,
   471	                ..
   472	            }
   473	            | Self::Refetch {
   474	                persistence_revision,
   475	            } => *persistence_revision,
   476	        }
   477	    }
   478	
   479	    pub fn requires_refetch(&self) -> bool {
   480	        matches!(self, Self::Refetch { .. })
   481	    }
   482	}

   491	///    Failed, missing, or result-before-call pairs do nothing. Refetch is already

- **Correct:** Session switching retires all prior agent, permission, projection, and canvas transports before fetching the replacement snapshot, with generation/session guards before asynchronous results are installed (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:1266-1282`, `:3344-3373`).
- **Correct:** Snapshot reduction follows canonical → aligned checkpoint → ordered pending content → authoritative folded state, and validates contiguous cursor sequence/prefix (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:1850-1958`).
- **Correct:** Tail processing drops duplicate cursors, restarts on gaps/prefix changes, scopes agent events to the selected session, handles inline/refetch checkpoints, and advances the cursor only after reduction (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:3693-3817`).
- **Correct:** Active/terminal/reroute/permission/browser folded state is installed without replaying folded agent/control frames a second time (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:3527-3623`).
- **Correct:** The proxy preserves projection query parameters and `Last-Event-ID` across browser reconnects (`crates/ocean-surface-proxy/src/main.rs:1130-1158`).

- **Blocker:** A projection-capable daemon is silently downgraded to legacy best-effort synchronization when `projection` remains temporarily unavailable after four retries (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:3475-3485`). The daemon explicitly may return canonical session detail with `projection: None` when revision alignment or the projection store is unavailable (`/private/tmp/ocean-os-session-projection-20260717/crates/ocean-daemon/src/main.rs:5223-5254`). Opening legacy `/v1/agent/events` afterward restores the snapshot/live race and forfeits exactly-once transcript/tool guarantees. Legacy fallback must remain restricted to `persistence_revision == None`; a new daemon should continue projection resync or fail visibly.

- **Blocker:** Canonical component reconstruction does not implement the daemon’s normative ordered call/result pairing. It builds a global call-ID map, then scans transcript results and treats missing `is_error` as success (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:5515-5541`). Consequently:
  - a result preceding its call can mount the later call;
  - duplicate call IDs select the last call;
  - repeated results can apply one call multiple times;
  - `is_error: None` is accepted rather than requiring `Some(false)`.

  The daemon contract requires scanning `tool_context` in order, consuming only a later explicitly successful matching result, with failed, missing, result-before-call, and repeated unmatched results having no effect (`/private/tmp/ocean-os-session-projection-20260717/crates/ocean-core/src/lib.rs:420-426`, `:446-450`, `:486-495`). The Surface wire type also omits result `is_error`/text fields, preventing compliant reconstruction (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:1688-1697`).
